name: iroh-do
description: iroh endpoints as TypeScript Durable Objects, over the wasm library crates/iroh-do-wasm

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.types: mkdir -p types && wrangler types --include-env=false --config test/unit/wrangler.toml types/runtime.d.ts && wrangler types --include-runtime=false --config test/unit/wrangler.toml types/test-env.d.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:wasm-test && npm run build:fixture && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
